description: This source file implements the ControlService plugin for a device, providing JSON-RPC methods and handling various system and control events related to remote controls, pairing, and device status updates. It manages event registration, processes incoming IARM events, and exposes multiple control and status methods through a JSON-RPC interface.

classes.name: ControlService
classes.description: Main plugin class providing control functionalities and event handling for remote controls and device status.

methods.name: getApiVersionNumber
methods.description: Returns the API version number of the plugin.

methods.name: getQuirks
methods.description: Returns a list of known quirks or issues.

methods.name: getAllRemoteData
methods.description: Retrieves data about all remote controls.

methods.name: getSingleRemoteData
methods.description: Retrieves data for a specific remote control given its ID.

methods.name: getLastKeypressSource
methods.description: Gets information about the last keypress event received.

methods.name: getLastPairedRemoteData
methods.description: Gets data about the last remote that was paired.

methods.name: startPairingMode
methods.description: Starts pairing mode with specified parameters.

methods.name: endPairingMode
methods.description: Ends pairing mode and returns the bind status.

methods.name: canFindMyRemote
methods.description: Checks if the device is capable of finding the remote.

methods.name: findLastUsedRemote
methods.description: Attempts to find the last used remote within a timeout period.

methods.name: checkRf4ceChipConnectivity
methods.description: Checks the connectivity status of the RF4CE chip.
